The categories provided in this census were: "Free white persons including heads of families" with a breakdown by age and sex; "All other free persons except Indians" "Slaves" The following are names extracted from the Federal Census Rolls. Some are known members of the mixed-race community; others are included because they have similar names and may or may not have been actual members of the community. The names are posted in alphabetical order but page numbers have been included to help show the proximity of many of the people to each other.
